name: Simple Rune
summary: A Simple Rune is an inscribed stone token passed to fledgling dwarven and gnomish warriors training in Coldridge Valley. It serves as a summons from the warrior trainer Thran Khorman, directing recruits to seek instruction inside Anvilmar.

sections.title: A Summons to Arms
sections.body: Carved with basic martial marks, the Simple Rune is handed to promising recruits who have begun clearing out the threats around Coldridge Valley. Rather than a magical charm, it acts as a formal calling stone from Thran Khorman, the resident warrior trainer at Anvilmar. Upon reading its inscribed guidance, a young fighter is expected to report directly to Thran to learn basic combat techniques and hear practical advice on surviving Dun Morogh's hostile wilds.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Simple Rune?
faq.answer: The Simple Rune is an instructional tablet given to novitiate warriors in Coldridge Valley. Reading it directs the recruit to present themselves to Thran Khorman inside Anvilmar for formal training.
It is sent by Thran Khorman, the dwarf warrior trainer stationed inside Anvilmar, who watches for promising fighters assisting around the valley.

faq.q: Where do I take the Simple Rune?
faq.answer: Take it to Thran Khorman inside the great forge hall of Anvilmar, located in central Coldridge Valley.

angles.text: For dwarven and gnomish warriors, this inscribed stone marks the first step into formal military training under veteran instructor Thran Khorman.
Dwarves traditionally rely on sturdy inscribed runes for orders, reminders, and martial summons rather than fragile parchment.
